## Description

Set of functions to draw ggplot2 graphics, written according to the [safer-R project](https://github.com/safer-r) specifications.

<br />

## Content
<br />

| Function | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **gg_box()** | ggplot2 boxplot + dots + means + median/mean values. |
| **gg_donut()** | ggplot2 donut. |
| **gg_empty()** | generate an empty graphic device with text in the middle. |
| **gg_get_legend()** | get the legend of ggplot objects. |
| **gg_heatmap()** | ggplot2 heatmap with the possibility to overlay a mask. |
| **gg_just()** | ggplot2 justification of annotated text or axis labeling, depending on angle. |
| **gg_miami()** | ggplot2 miami plot (Manhattan plot with a top and a bottom part). |
| **gg_palette()** | select colors on the ggplot2 default color palette. |
| **gg_point_rast()** | ggplot2 raster scatterplot layer. |
| **gg_scatter()** | ggplot2 scatterplot + lines (up to 6 overlays totally). |

<br />

See the articles (in the GitHub repository) for more examples of each function: [gg_box](https://github.com/safer-r/saferGG/blob/main/vignettes/articles/gg_box.Rmd), [gg_donut](https://github.com/safer-r/saferGG/blob/main/vignettes/articles/gg_donut.Rmd), [gg_empty](https://github.com/safer-r/saferGG/blob/main/vignettes/articles/gg_empty.Rmd), [gg_get_legend](https://github.com/safer-r/saferGG/blob/main/vignettes/articles/gg_get_legend.Rmd), [gg_heatmap](https://github.com/safer-r/saferGG/blob/main/vignettes/articles/gg_heatmap.Rmd), [gg_just](https://github.com/safer-r/saferGG/blob/main/vignettes/articles/gg_just.Rmd), [gg_miami](https://github.com/safer-r/saferGG/blob/main/vignettes/articles/gg_miami.Rmd), [gg_palette](https://github.com/safer-r/saferGG/blob/main/vignettes/articles/gg_palette.Rmd), [gg_point_rast](https://github.com/safer-r/saferGG/blob/main/vignettes/articles/gg_point_rast.Rmd), [gg_scatter](https://github.com/safer-r/saferGG/blob/main/vignettes/articles/gg_scatter.Rmd).
